context.body: Cosmic incomparability answers a community’s fear of being unseen.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The LORD measures creation, has no instructor or equal, rules nations, names the stars, and gives strength to the weary.
observations.label: God is incomparable and attends the weary: action

observations.body: Exiles who say their way is hidden are called to look, know, wait, and renew strength.
observations.label: God is incomparable and attends the weary: response

observations.body: Who has measured? · to whom then? · calls them by name · gives power
observations.label: Words in Isaiah 40:12–31

payload.posture: Read Isaiah 40:12–31 as the prophetic voice evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The passage moves from scale to care without explaining suffering as proof of divine absence.
payload.title: God is incomparable and attends the weary
